			/* ── grid & cards ── */
.newsletter-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px,1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
}

.newsletter-card {
  position: relative;
  border: 2px solid #ddd;
  border-radius: 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: #fff;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: border-color .2s, background .2s;
}

.newsletter-card input {
  opacity: 0;
  position: absolute;
}

.card-img img {
  width: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.card-inner {
  padding: 1rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.card-icon {
  font-size: 2rem;
  margin-bottom: .5rem;
}

.card-icon::before {
  content: "\002B";
}

.newsletter-card.checked .card-icon::before {
  content: "\2713";
  color: #003366;
  transform: rotate(360deg);
  display: inline-block;
  transition: transform .3s;
}

/* TITLE = old description size (.9rem) */
.card-title {
  font-weight: bold;
  margin-bottom: .25rem;
  text-transform: none;
  font-size: .9rem;    /* ← swapped in */
}

/* SUBTITLE stays unchanged */
.card-sub {
  font-size: .85rem;
  color: #666;
  text-transform: none;
}

/* DESCRIPTION = old title size (1rem) */
.card-desc {
  margin-top: .5rem;
  font-size: 0.8rem;     /* ← swapped in */
  line-height: 1.4;
  color: #333;
  text-transform: none;
  font-weight: normal;
}

.newsletter-card.checked {
  border-color: #003366;
  background: #e6f0fa;
}

.article-header-featured-image figcaption {
	padding-left: 0px !important;
}

/* ── footer panel ── */
.selection-footer {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: -300px;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  background: #fff;
  border-top: 2px solid #003366;
  box-shadow: 0 -4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.1);
  transition: bottom .3s;
  z-index: 999;
}

.selection-footer.visible {
  bottom: 0;
}

.selection-footer .footer-handle {
  padding: 1rem;
  font-weight: bold;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
}

.selection-footer .footer-handle .count {
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  margin-right: .5rem;
}

.selection-footer .toggle-panel {
  margin-left: 1rem;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.selection-footer .footer-content {
  max-height: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  transition: max-height .3s;
  padding: 0 1rem;
}

.selection-footer.open .footer-content {
  max-height: 500px;
  padding: 1rem;
}

.selection-footer input[type="email"],
.selection-footer input[type="text"],
.selection-footer select {
  width: 100%;
  padding: .5rem;
  margin-top: .25rem;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.selection-footer p {
  margin: .75rem 0;
}

.selection-footer .consent input {
  margin-right: .5rem;
}

.selection-footer .submit-row {
  text-align: center;
  margin-top: 1rem;
}

.selection-footer .submit-row button {
  background: #003366;
  color: #fff;
  border: none;
  padding: .75rem 1.5rem;
  font-size: 1rem;
  border-radius: 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

/* ── Newsletter Banner ── */
#mc_embed_signup { background-color: #ededed !important;
    padding: 10px !important;
	border-radius: 15px;
}
